summary: Final one-shot: uv run analysis.py scores heldout once with the frozen procedure
reasoning: The procedure and its estimate protocol are frozen (step-32: cv_auc 0.6622 over 30 nested folds, pilot only); analysis.py now reproduces that estimate, tunes the final C/gamma on the whole pilot, and reads data/heldout.csv exactly once at the end. Pilot-only evidence (est. 0.6622; best fold-refit SVM configs ~0.675 vs forest 0.7267, whose own holdout was 0.6989) says the RBF-SVM route most likely lands around 0.67-0.70 holdout, so I do not expect the route's 0.71 floor to be reached; the gap condition should hold because the nested estimate is if anything conservative (360-sample fold fits vs 400-sample final fit). Expectations: clean exit; holdout_auc >= 0.66 (my belief, below the 0.71 route floor); gap within +/-0.05; n_features = 25 <= 50. If holdout lands >= 0.71 the route goal is met; otherwise the honest estimate stands as the answer I would defend.
